source_variant_note: Both variants are source_base_commit with source_patches applied as of a commit of this repository: later_formal as of b6c9245 (unchanged since), seed42_fp32_pretrain as of c797fd6, before ternary-model.patch existed. ternary-model.patch adds the ternary weight scheme; FP32 and uniform quantization build the same layers with the same arguments.
runner_note: runner_commits gives the commit of this repository whose file content each runner matches. Later commits change train_stage.py only for ternary weights and finetune_queue.sh only by the FP32_PARENTS option. The seed42/fp32/pretrain and seed42/qap_w8a8/pretrain stages ran train_stage.py as of commit 05b21a8 (sha256 b345b56897404169a44c51758b68cd3c923473863edb70e30ccb7d8855d5d1ec), which lacks only the three-class fine-tuning support; pretraining is the same. launch_batches_v4.sh only orders the queue runs.
scope: Stages and PTQ sweeps behind the TUAR, TUAB and TUSL v2 results. The seed42 TUSL v1 runs used the later_formal source and the same train_stage.py and calibrate.py.
